title_ar: Hamdan bin Mohammed attends wedding reception
brief: Dubai Crown Prince His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum attended today a wedding reception hosted by Ghanem Mohammed Ghanem Al Marri to celebrate the wedding of his son Khalifa to the daughter of Abdullah Jumaa Abdulla AlQuod.
text: Dubai Crown Prince His Highness Sheikh Hamdan bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum attended today a wedding reception hosted by Ghanem Mohammed Ghanem Al Marri to celebrate the wedding of his son Khalifa to the daughter of Abdullah Jumaa Abdulla AlQuod. The wedding reception took place at Meydan Hotel, in the presence of a number of sheikhs, officials and families of the groom and the bride. Sheikh Hamdan congratulated the newlyweds and wished them a happy married life.
